integrity: Proof derives universal statements symbolically; attached exhaustive checks cover only q=2,3,4,5. General ideal-embedding literature was checked only at abstract level.
scientific_limitations: Only two-dimensional commutative algebras with full square; finite-field enumeration of labeled structures, not isomorphism types. Scalar-extension removal of irreducibility is asserted for finite fields. Historical overlap with older tensor literature remains possible.
title: Binary-quadratic trichotomy and exact census for two-dimensional stable squares
